description: Key facts a correct lesson on each Analog Electronics topic must state. Every fact was taken from the fetched text of the source page named with it (the quote is checked by `npm run golden:check`). Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions matched against the lesson text after LaTeX backslashes and braces are removed.
subject: analog-electronics

facts.claim: Gain is the ratio of output to input

source.quote: The amount of amplification provided by an amplifier is measured by its gain: the ratio of output voltage, current, or power to input

facts.claim: An amplifier is a two-port that uses supply power to enlarge a signal

source.quote: It is a two-port electronic circuit that uses electric power from a power supply to increase the amplitude

facts.claim: Nonlinear devices replaced by linear elements around the bias point

source.quote: the nonlinear circuit elements are replaced by linear elements whose values are given by the first-order (linear) approximation

facts.claim: Valid when AC signals are small relative to DC bias

source.quote: the AC signals (i.e., the time-varying currents and voltages in the circuit) are small relative to the DC bias currents and voltages

facts.claim: Class A has poor efficiency and runs hot

source.quote: class-A amplifiers have poor efficiency and heat is generated in the transistor

facts.claim: Class AB is between class A and class B

source.quote: Class AB is between class A and class B

facts.claim: Negative feedback subtracts part of the output from the input

source.quote: subtracts a fraction of its output from its input

facts.claim: It stabilises gain and improves linearity and bandwidth

source.quote: The applied negative feedback can improve its performance (gain stability, linearity, frequency response, step response)

facts.claim: Loop phase shift is 0 or a multiple of 2π (360°)

source.quote: The phase shift around the loop is zero or an integer multiple of 2π

facts.claim: Loop gain βA (|βA| = 1)

source.quote: so βA is the loop gain around the feedback loop

facts.claim: A current mirror copies a current through another device

source.quote: A current mirror is a circuit designed to copy a current through one active device by controlling the current in another active device

facts.claim: The output transistor must stay in the active region

source.quote: keep the output transistor of the mirror in active mode

facts.claim: Amplifies the difference between two inputs, rejects what is common

source.quote: amplifies the difference between two input voltages but suppresses any voltage common to the two inputs

facts.claim: Low common-mode gain is wanted (high CMRR)

source.quote: a low common-mode gain is usually desired

facts.claim: Active filters use amplifiers (op-amps)

source.quote: An active filter is a type of analog circuit implementing an electronic filter using active components, typically an amplifier

facts.claim: The amplifier isolates the filter from the load

source.quote: An amplifier prevents the load impedance of the following stage from affecting the characteristics of the filter

facts.claim: A DAC converts a digital signal into analog

source.quote: is a system that converts a digital signal into an analog signal

facts.claim: An ADC converts an analog signal into a digital number

source.quote: converts an analog input voltage or current to a digital number

facts.claim: Digital output is proportional to the input

source.quote: the digital output is a two's complement binary number that is proportional to the input

facts.claim: An op-amp can act as a comparator

source.quote: An operational amplifier can, if necessary, be forced to act as a comparator

facts.claim: Bode plots show magnitude and phase against frequency

source.quote: Bode plots graph magnitude and phase against frequency

facts.claim: Magnitude is usually in decibels

source.quote: typically in decibels (dB)
